steps.title: Self Service Ordering
steps.navDesc: Dealer browses product categories and places orders directly through the self-service menu — end-to-end without a salespersonSelf-serviceOrderingCatalog

steps.title: Catalog Browse & Order
steps.navDesc: Dealer browses a rich product catalog with real images and pricing, adds to cart, and checks out in one seamless flowCatalogCart & CheckoutOrdering

steps.title: AI Order Capture
steps.navDesc: Dealer sends a handwritten order note on WhatsApp; ZoAi reads it and converts it into a structured digital order automaticallyAI AgentsOrder CaptureAutomation

steps.title: Back Office Order Fulfilment
steps.navDesc: Admin PortalBack-office team reviews all pending dealer orders in the ZoTok portal and accepts the order — triggering ERP billing and WhatsApp confirmation

steps.title: Order Confirmed Notification
steps.navDesc: Utility TemplatePWA WebViewDealer receives WhatsApp confirmation once order is approved — views read-only order details on mobile PWA

steps.title: SAP Integration Architecture
steps.navDesc: ArchitectureConfirmed orders are pushed from ZoTok to SAP via the integration layer — triggering the full order-to-bill cycle in SAP SD/FI

steps.title: Invoice & Dispatch
steps.navDesc: Utility TemplateZoTok sends the invoice PDF and dispatch note with transporter details as soon as the order is billed and shipped

steps.title: Cash Discount & Payment Reminder
steps.navDesc: Utility TemplateZoTok auto-sends cash discount reminder (T-1) and due date reminder to prompt early payment

steps.title: Payment Received
steps.navDesc: Utility TemplateInteractive ListDealer receives payment receipt and gets settlement confirmation on WhatsApp

steps.title: Credit Note & Ledger
steps.navDesc: Utility TemplateWebViewSAP FI raises credit note via webhook; ZoTok notifies dealer on WhatsApp with PDF and ledger statement
